summary: Defines the not-so-stubby area (NSSA), an OSPF area type that behaves like a stub area but can still import a limited set of external routes. This helps sites that attach outside networks to an otherwise simple area. It was a proposed standard and was replaced by RFC 3101.

eli5.summary: A small neighborhood normally blocks outside traffic. This lets one gate stay open so a few outside roads can connect. It has since been replaced by a newer design.
